## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `Palette-Pro-x.y.dmg` | Mac app installer: open it and drag Palette Pro to Applications |
| `Palette-Pro-x.y-mac.zip` | The same Mac app as a zip |
| `Palette-Pro-x.y-web.zip` | The web app: unzip and open `index.html` in any browser |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for the files above |

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later on an Apple silicon Mac.

**First launch on a Mac:** the app isn't notarized by Apple, so macOS asks the first time. Open it once, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. You can also run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Palette Pro.app"`.
